entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Reconsider Deprecating Extensions.ApiDescription.Client #62980
  • Perf improvement: ApiCrudListProducts #62978
  • Perf regression: updates #62977
  • Perf improvement: json #62976
  • OpenAPI Feedback: services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions was needed for casing to be picked up for JsonPropertyName in generation #62975
  • OpenAPI: ICollection should generate as readOnly:true but does not. #62974
  • OpenAPI: Delta<> From OData days generates really weird. #62973
  • OpenAPI: Any type inside of Task<ActionResult<WorkInProgressResult>> (e.g., WorkInProgressResult is not included in the schema #62972
  • OpenAPI: No support for detecting which endpoints access Request.Body for streaming purposes #62971
  • OpenAPI: Xml Documentation includes special new line characters that differ from previous versions. #62970
  • OpenAPI: /// <response code="404">The web hook could not be found.</response> are missing from the generated output. #62969
  • OpenAPI: Enums are missing description, and x-enumNames #62968
  • OpenAPI: Schemas is missing child types. For example I have CountResult which has a Dictionary<string, IAggregate>. IAggregate is not genereated nor any derived types. #62967
  • OpenAPI: Version Props are missing the version pattern "pattern": "^\\d+(\\.\\d+){1,3}$" #62966
  • OpenAPI: Enums with JsonStringEnumMemberName are not handled. You have to specifically set [JsonConverter(typeof(StringEnumConverter))] #62965
  • OpenAPI: [Required] public required string ShouldHaveMinLength { get; init; } is marked as required but doens't have a minlength #62964
  • OpenAPI long props are generated as integer | string types with a regex pattern #62963
  • OpenAPI HashSets doesn't generate correctly #62962
  • Perf improvement: ApiCrudListProducts #62960

Closed

  • Perf regression: fortunes #62959
  • Services injected with attribute derived from FromKeyedServicesAttribute appear as request body in swagger #58739
    Backlog
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Razor.RuntimeCompilation (v8.0.16) includes outdated references #62144
  • OpenAPI Issues/ Feeback #62150
  • QuickGrid has a race condition with disposal during init #47173
    Backlog
  • Announcement 524 missing issue and PR link #62961
  • Perf regression: json #62953
  • Make PropertyNameCaseInsensitive available for JSON->gRPC transcoding #50401
    10.0-rc1

  • Add passkey count and name length limits #62979
    area-blazor
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62956
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops

    area-mvc, community-contribution, 10.0-rc1
  • Update SignalR Redis tests to use internal Docker Hub mirror #62936
    area-signalr, 10.0-rc1
  • Fixed race condition in the disposing of the QuickGrid #62840
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • Add gRPC JSON transcoding option for case insensitive field names #62868
    area-grpc, 10.0-rc1

Updated

    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • [release/10.0-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62912
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
